events.verdict: The shot is imminent within three seconds of Zubac (LAC) being positioned in the lane.
Green (GSW) briefly grabs and releases Zubac's (LAC) jersey as the two players engage and disengage during the rebound.
Westbrook (LAC) and Curry (GSW) each get their hands on the loose ball and the body contact between them is incidental.
Curry (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes OOB.
Green (GSW) firms up on his left foot while establishing himself in Westbrook's (LAC) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Harden (LAC) releases away from the contact with Wiggins (GSW) as he drives on the perimeter.
Green (GSW) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Kuminga (GSW) lowers his arm and initiates contact with Coffey's (LAC) right arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Thompson (GSW) commits a take foul on Westbrook (LAC).
Westbrook (LAC) leans into Podziemski (GSW), but the contact is marginal and he is not dislodged from his defensive position as a result of the contact.
Green (GSW) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Wiggins (GSW) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).  The illegal contact occurs when Harden is already in his shooting motion and a shooting foul should be assessed instead.
Westbrook (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Podziemski (GSW) during the shot attempt near the rim.
